title: docs(patches): link the radix focus-scope patch to radix-ui/primitives#4226 (objectui#13466)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DKJWNXtUcpBxinVEpnKRxYK)_

Refs #13466 (red branch of the claim, comment 6392490658).

## What

`patches/README.md` only. The `@radix-ui/react-focus-scope` patch stays; its README entry now has:

- **Upstream:** radix-ui/primitives#4226 (same root cause, found by comment 6395691379 on #13466), with the closed radix-ui/primitives#4148 as related.
- **Last measured:** 2026-10-25, stock `1.3.1` with the patch removed, race case red (1 failed / 2 passed).
- **Remove when:** radix-ui/primitives#4226 is fixed in a released `@radix-ui/react-focus-scope` and the regression test is green on that release with the patch removed. The old condition named no upstream item, so nothing outside could trigger it.

## Measurement (worktree off `main` `6f629a7`)

| Setup | `dialog-popover-focus-scope.test.tsx` |
|---|---|
| patched `1.1.16` (lockfile as on main) | 3 passed |
| stock `1.3.1`: `patchedDependencies` removed, `pnpm.overrides` pinned to `1.3.1`; resolution from `@radix-ui/react-dialog`'s directory confirmed to land on `1.3.1` | 1 failed / 2 passed. The failing test is "a re-run of the trapped scope effect must not evict it — the popover still pauses the dialog trap": `document.activeElement` is the dialog's button, not the popover input |

The source of `1.3.1` and of `1.3.2-rc.1791984254107` still schedules `focusScopesStack.remove(focusScope)` in a `setTimeout` that nothing cancels. The measurement edits were reverted; this PR does not touch `package.json` or the lockfile.

Not read directly: radix-ui/primitives#4226 itself (this session has no access to that repo). The link and its description come from comment 6395691379 on #13466.
